implementation.change: core composition::lens::trace searches (function, may-return) states and classifies each SUPPLIES_DATA step as an argument or a return by the call site it cites; adapter semantic::rust CHAIN_LINKS_PER_LEVEL = 6; adapter semantic::rust::resolve ImplDef.trait_generic and the generic-trait-impl refusal in associated(); adapter dependency::cargo DeclaredSource per dependency entry and workspace_dependencies (workspace.dependencies, patch.*); runtime census::resolution crate_targets binds by the package directory a declaration resolves to (ADR 0082)
